warnings.title: 1 existing nonblank value(s) become blank
warnings.detail: If you import with “Overwrite products with matching handles,” included blank columns can overwrite existing values. Review every listed cell before importing.

warnings.title: 1 row(s) have a changed Handle despite a matching unique SKU
warnings.detail: Shopify uses Handle to match products when overwriting. A changed Handle may be imported as a new product instead of updating the original. Confirm the intended product identity in Shopify before importing.

notes: Packed size checks cover partial proposed values and Requires shipping=false using current header names only. Units, numeric validity, shipping aliases, all-blank size clearing and the complete import schema are not validated.
This compares files locally; it does not connect to Shopify or upload either file.
Column names are normalized for comparison. Shopify requires exact template headers, including case; verify both files against the current Shopify CSV format.
A report is a review aid, not a guarantee that an import is safe. Verify against Shopify's current documentation and your import settings.
